title: olea rotundifolia
intro: Olea rotundifolia, commonly known as the wild olive tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Oleaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The bioactive constituents of Olea rotundifolia, such as oleuropein and hydroxytyrosol, have been identified to exhibit therapeutic actions including cardiovascular protection and anti-cancer effects. The extracts of this plant have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and skin problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
